main_question: Among same-aged living birds in the same current reproductive state and colony-year, does a longer PREVIOUS success/failure/nonbreeding sequence predict future attempt/fledging beyond current state, individual quality, prior participation, observation effort and calendar effects?

source_metadata.author_explicit_request: Contact Grant Ballard / Point Blue team before undertaking further detailed longitudinal analyses because of source corrections, interpretation complexity and possible concurrent projects

prior_art_that_blocks_simple_claims.paper: Lescroel et al 2009 J Anim Ecol DOI 10.1111/j.1365-2656.2009.01542.x
prior_art_that_blocks_simple_claims.already_shown: Successful, failed and deferred breeders differ in next-year state transition and survival; source MCMR WBWA test chi2 24.22 df12 p0.02 indicates lack of simple model fit, NOT an established memory mechanism
Icebergs increased breeder dispersal, Royds->Bird >3% versus usual <1%; environmental plasticity of adult fidelity is not novel

prior_art_that_blocks_simple_claims.paper: Kappes et al 2021 J Anim Ecol DOI 10.1111/1365-2656.13422
prior_art_that_blocks_simple_claims.already_shown: Age of first reproduction, improved experience, selective appearance/disappearance, heterogeneous reproductive success; the Dryad 2020 data are the original paper dataset

prior_art_that_blocks_simple_claims.paper: Dugger et al 2026 Front Ecol Evol DOI 10.3389/fevo.2026.1868960
prior_art_that_blocks_simple_claims.already_shown: 25-year marked three-colony multistate transition/detection, age-specific prebreeder and adult movement, local recruitment and sabbaticals (20-30%)

prior_art_that_blocks_simple_claims.paper: Flynn et al 2026 Ecological Modelling DOI 10.1016/j.ecolmodel.2026.111488
prior_art_that_blocks_simple_claims.already_shown: Age-structured local breeding propensity and environment constrained eight Peninsula populations; occupancy cycles not a new mechanism

source_eligibility_gates: Before reading individual behavioral records check only file-format, source URL and CSV HEADER; collect no animal IDs and no model results during this first probe
official HTTPS datadryad.org only; all redirects must remain HTTPS and *.datadryad.org
stop on HTML/Cloudflare, missing file or over 2MiB
compare actual HEADER with Dryad's published columns, never manufacture unavailable detection or exact death information
do not merge recoded IDs with 2026/2010/2009/2013 USAP-DC or another paper's data
source authors ask to be contacted before new longitudinal reanalysis; treat new scientific outcome fitting as HOLD pending consultation/provenance check
breeder=0 means NOT OBSERVED participating, not proof alive and skipped breeding
success=0 when breeder=1 is nest failure; for breeder=0 success may be unknown/not applicable and must never be coded as failed reproduction
yearly records with no ID-row are UNKNOWN not a nonbreeder, and resighting/detection probabilities vary by age/state/colony
require at least 3 consecutive yearly observed occasions with same within-dataset recoded ID, documented alive/at-risk to define second-order history
freeze biologically sensible lag history and year-heldout validation before reading future reproductive outcomes
separate individual persistent quality, selective survival, age, calendar-year marine conditions and attendance detection from state dependence
if no independent prospective/experimental variation in prior failure or shock exists do not infer a causal memory or recovery mechanism

competing_predictions_if_access_and_perm.H0_latent_individual_quality_plus_first_: Once age, current state, stable individual quality and year are controlled, the second previous state and cumulative failures add no measurable out-of-year predictive information
competing_predictions_if_access_and_perm.H1_longer_history_state_dependence: Within same age/current state, earlier failed sequences improve out-of-year predictions of next true attendance/breeding propensity or fledging after accounting for missing and detection
competing_predictions_if_access_and_perm.H2_environment_and_selection: Apparent memory vanishes once reproductive opportunity, death/absence missingness, year-specific forcing and selective persistence are considered
competing_predictions_if_access_and_perm.H3_observer_artifact: A memory signature disappears when original years 2002+ with earlier census coverage, observed alive and stable effort are used

analytical_negative_control.analytic_model: two equal stable quality classes with independent Bernoulli yearly success p=0.8 vs 0.2
analytical_negative_control.result_interpretation: mathematical confounding counterexample, not observed penguin ecology
